Root files
|.gitignore — tells Git which files/folders to never commit (build output, secrets, AMF1 content, OS junk).
|CNAME — single-line file telling GitHub Pages to serve the site at the custom domain jayjaybee.com.
|Gemfile — declares the Ruby gems needed to build the site locally (github-pages + webrick), matching what GitHub Pages uses.
|Gemfile.lock — auto-generated record of the exact gem versions resolved on your last bundle install (gitignored because GitHub Pages locks its own).
|README.md — human-readable repo intro shown on the GitHub page (excluded from the built site).
|SKILL.md — your Claude Code project notes/conventions, kept local and not published (gitignored + excluded by Jekyll).
|_config.yml — Jekyll's central config: site title/URL, layout defaults for the FC26 sub-project, and the list of files Jekyll should not publish.
|index.html — the homepage content, wrapped at build time by _layouts/default.html.
|
|----_layouts/
	|default.html — the shared page chrome (head, body, header, footer, theme script, asset links) that wraps every page declaring layout: default.
	|wiki-entry.html — the shell around every /projects/wiki/<slug>/ write-up. Nests inside default.html, so it adds only the rail, article head, infobox, backlinks and pager. Reads every entry page at build time; there is no separate manifest.
|
|-----templates/
	|starting-template.html — blank page scaffold to copy when creating a new page: front matter + an empty body, since header, footer, background, and type all come from _layouts/default.html and assets/css/global.css. Excluded from the built site; repo reference only.
|
|assets/css/
	|variables.css — design-system tokens (colors, spacing, type scale, breakpoints) used by every other stylesheet.
	|global.css — base resets and element-level defaults (typography, links, body) that apply site-wide.
	|components.css — styles for reusable UI pieces (buttons, chips, cards, nav, etc.).
	|layout.css — page-level structure and section rhythm (the .page, .section-head, role/work/now list layouts).
	|wiki.css — the /projects/wiki layer only: entry rail, article head, infobox, footnotes, backlinks, pager, launch button. Token-only; declares no colour, size or spacing of its own.
|
|assets/js/
	|main.js — placeholder for site-wide non-motion JS, loaded on every page.
	|animations.js — theme toggle, nav dropdowns, reveal-on-scroll, stagger, and anchor behavior.
	|wiki.js — loaded only on wiki entry pages. Builds the "On this page" rail from the article headings and shows the hover preview on internal wiki links. Pure progressive enhancement.
|
|assets/fonts/ and assets/images/
	|.gitkeep — empty marker files so Git tracks the otherwise-empty directories.
|
|files/
	|CV.pdf — your downloadable CV, linked from the site.
|
|-----_includes/
	|wiki-body.html — compiles the two wiki markup conventions at build time: [[slug|label]] into an internal link, ((text)) into a numbered footnote. Carried forward from the design bundle, which did the same two transforms in the browser.
|
|projects/
	|index.html — the projects landing page. Buttons point at /projects/wiki/<slug>/, not at the apps.
	|
	|----wiki/
		|index.html — index of write-ups, generated from the entry pages themselves. Built from the site's own .work-* components, so it needs nothing from wiki.css.
		|<slug>/index.html — one write-up per project (gaffer-iq, fc26-calculator). Front matter plus body prose; everything else comes from _layouts/wiki-entry.html. Each carries a single "Launch app" link out to /projects/apps/<slug>/.
	|
	|----apps/
		|<slug>/ — standalone apps. Own their entire document, share no code with the site or with each other, and are excluded from the Jekyll layout in _config.yml. Nothing outside them links in except the one Launch button per wiki entry.
